capabilities: load custom SVG icons from a dedicated folder
preview icons in a searchable grid in settings
reload icons via a ribbon button or settings
copy icon references with one click
convert black fills and strokes to currentColor for theme support
extras: The README carries a security disclaimer: SVG files can be scriptable and dangerous, and the plugin does only basic sanitization. The author also notes the code was largely AI-written and lists known limitations (no delete/rename, manual reload, no nested folders, no file size limits).
motivation: The author made it because they couldn't find any alternatives whatsoever and the idea 'triggered a brain-itch that I couldn't get rid of'.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to register your own SVG files as icons that other plugins can reference.
summary: Plugin that loads your own SVG files as custom icons into Obsidian's icon library, for use with other plugins that accept icon references.
